A '''battle''' was fought at [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] in [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], when the [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|''Executor''-class Star Dreadnought]] ''[[Whelm]]'' and the [[Mandator III-class dreadnought|''Mandator III''-class dreadnought]] ''[[Panthac]]'' destroyed each other in battle.
